Are you looking to optimise your healthspan and support cellular longevity? The science of aging has revealed powerful compounds that can help protect your cells, enhance mitochondrial function, and promote healthy longevity. In this comprehensive guide, we’ll explore evidence-based longevity supplements backed by published research from leading scientific journals.  
Before diving into specific supplements, it’s essential to understand the key cellular pathways that influence aging. Modern longevity research has identified several critical mechanisms that determine how we age:  
The supplements we’ll discuss work through these scientifically validated pathways to support healthy aging at the cellular level.  
NMN has emerged as one of the most promising longevity supplements due to its ability to efficiently boost NAD+ levels. Research published in *Nature Cell Biology* demonstrates that NMN administration markedly extended the lifespan of yeast, flies and worms, and human immune cells.  
Clinical studies show impressive results. Human trials with Uthever™ NMN demonstrated up to 38% increases in NAD+ levels after just 60 days of supplementation. The mechanism is straightforward: NMN serves as a direct precursor to NAD+, helping restore the declining levels that naturally occur with aging.
Studies in mice have shown that NMN supports mitochondrial function, prevents cellular senescence, and enhances metabolic health. Research in *PMC* indicates that NMN possesses beneficial longevity properties by restoring the activity of NAD+-dependent deacetylase sirtuin 1 (SIRT1), which in turn improves mitochondrial function and prevents cellular senescence.

CoQ10 is essential for mitochondrial energy production and acts as a powerful antioxidant. Research demonstrates that CoQ10 levels in the body decline as we age, affecting energy metabolism, which is associated with cellular aging and various age-related diseases.  
A groundbreaking study combining NMN and CoQ10 showed remarkable cardiovascular benefits. The research found that the combined treatment was more effective than either compound alone, reducing irregular heart rhythms and improving heart function after cardiac stress.  
By supplementing with CoQ10, you support the electron transport chain in mitochondria, enhancing ATP production and reducing oxidative damage to cells.

PQQ stands out for its unique ability to stimulate the creation of new mitochondria, a process called mitochondrial biogenesis. Studies show that PQQ stimulates the generation of new mitochondria, enhance cellular energy metabolism, and slow down the decline of mitochondrial function associated with ageing.  
This powerful compound also functions as an antioxidant, neutralising free radicals and reducing cellular oxidative damage. The combination of increased mitochondrial numbers and reduced oxidative stress makes PQQ a valuable addition to any longevity-focused supplement regimen.

Resveratrol, a polyphenol found in red wine and grapes, has been extensively studied for its longevity-promoting properties. Research published in *Nature Cell Biology* established that mice treated with sirtuin-activating compounds (STACs) such as resveratrol have improved organ function, physical endurance, disease resistance and longevity.  
The compound works by allosterically activating SIRT1, effectively mimicking some benefits of caloric restriction without reducing food intake. Studies across multiple species demonstrate that resveratrol can extend lifespan and improve healthspan by enhancing mitochondrial function, reducing inflammation, and supporting metabolic health.
